headline: Emerging Stock: Ruiyan Aims for Next Wave of Growth; Chairman: Module Share Rising, Breakeven Depends on Verification Progress - Finance
summary: Ruiyan Technology is moving from high-margin millimeter-wave measurement instruments toward satellite, defense and fixed wireless access module businesses. The chairman says projects depend on customer verification and mass-production preparations.
why: Ruiyan Technology is a Taiwan-listed electronics company, and shifts in product mix toward defense and satellite communications affect its margins and revenue visibility for investors.
